item.description:

Title of the project: " Interaction among elicitors, biological control agents, and insecticides in the management of agricultural insect pests". The compatibility among elicitors, biological control agents, and insecticides will be thoroughly assessed develop effective and sustainable integrated pest management strategies. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Evaluation of different graft combination in citrus plants subjected to deficit irrigation (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The project will address some of the main challenges associated with sustainable irrigation management in citrus production, with particular reference to the increasing limitations in water availability under Mediterranean conditions. In this context, the selection of suitable rootstock/scion combinations represents an important strategy for improving plant adaptation to water stress and enhancing water-use efficiency. To this end, the research will: i) evaluate different citrus rootstock/scion combinations; ii) characterize their physiological, vegetative, and productive responses to deficit irrigation conditions; and iii) identify the combinations with the greatest water-use efficiency…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-04 Ingegneria agraria, forestale e dei biosistemi

The research activity will focus on the development and implementation of an integrated chain of sensors and measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of the main operating parameters of extra virgin olive oil extraction plants. The acquired data will be used to develop predictive models and control strategies aimed at process automation and smart management, according to Industry 4.0 and Artificial Intelligence principles. The activity will include the assessment of machine and plant performance, with particular attention to extraction efficiency, energy consumption, and optimization of operating conditions. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Development of quantitative tools for insect population dynamics (Univ. BRESCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 14:00
Institution: Univ. BRESCIA, Brescia
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

The research activity will focus on developing innovative approaches for modelling and predicting the dynamics of insect populations of agricultural relevance. It will include the development of mathematical and statistical models, estimation of biological parameters and functional relationships, model calibration and uncertainty quantification, integrating data from laboratory experiments, field monitoring and scientific literature. Statistical and machine-learning approaches will be explored to improve model inference and predictive performance.
